review_scope: Source question-body crop fidelity. Separate preparation and independent review inspected full source pages and all actual output parts. External answer scoring and neighboring questions excluded; original body notation and figures preserved.
limitations: Not answer recertification, original-source completeness, accessible transcription or redistribution authorization. Browser QA remains blocked.

findings: Independently opened all nine full source-page images and twelve contact sheets covering all 69 records and 134 actual renderer-produced WEBP parts; compared printed labels, complete available stems, choices, diagrams, tables, code and final task lines. No clipping or unrelated neighboring subpart leakage found.
All 69 IDs match records.json; each printed_question_number was compared against its source item. Normalized numbering does not replace the printed subpart labels in the images.
Fresh renderer output at 3x and WEBP quality 80 is byte-identical to every reviewed output. Exact source hash and proposal hash match the assignment.

All 293 geometric overlap pairs independently recomputed and reconciled against explicit audit entries; every pair has identical bounds. No nonidentical overlaps exist. All repeated regions are shared instructions, common stems or the specifically necessary memory component table.

Q1–Q10 share fill-in instructions (45 pairs); Q11–Q30 share multiple-correct instructions (190); Q31–Q38 share short-answer instructions (28); Q32–Q35 additionally share two-pass assembler stem (6). Independent bodies remain separate, including side-by-side printed 3(ii.a/b).

Q44/Q45 share the memory-system specification and the component table (2 pairs). Table speed information is necessary for EERAM timing, while the separate Q44 design request is excluded from Q45. Q46/Q47 share complete function code and positive-n condition (1 pair), retaining only their own separate task lines.

Q49–Q52 share the constant-time set representation stem and concluding pictorial/routine/initialization requirements (12 pairs); Q59–Q61 share redundancy stem and one-line-answer instruction (6); Q67–Q69 share proof instruction (3). None of these shared regions contains neighboring independent tasks.

Source defects remain unchanged: missing L/R prefixes in Q23 choices, missing connective in Q65 assertion (2), malformed Q27 identities, ambiguous Q26 association, repeated two-address wording in Q6, RAM 6K and mHz in Q44/Q45, and function-code ambiguity in Q46/Q47. Source blur and in-body watermark artifacts are not repaired. Website footers are excluded.
